description: Papers by one author, most cited first. Matches the author name as it is written on the papers, so exact spelling matters. Inputs: author (required, the name as it appears on the paper, for example Jane Doe), from_year (optional earliest publication year), open_access_only (optional, false by default), limit (optional, 1 to 25, default 8). Example prompt: 'list papers by John Dewey on education since 1950.'

author.description: The author name as it appears on the paper, for example Jane Doe.

from_year.description: Only papers published in or after this year.

limit.description: How many results to return, 1 to 25.

open_access_only.description: Only papers with a free to read copy.

name: list_author_papers
title: List papers by an author
